During a '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] attacked the world. Forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] repelled the invaders and destroyed the Charon's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], ''[[Desolate]]''.<ref name="O2I" /> Nevertheless, the Alliance suffered heavy losses. One of the few survivors was the [[Morellian]]&ndash;[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] [[Tole Warren]].<ref name="AIR2">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
